newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba has no comment on SBC talks.
newsitem.headline: Veba has no comment on SBC talks.

text.p: German utility Veba AG on Tuesday would not comment on press reports that it had been approached by SBC Communications, but confirmed that it was talking to several potential buyers of a stake in its telecoms venture.
There would be a stake of up at least 22 percent in Veba's telecommunications venture with RWE, should the third partner Cable and Wireless pull out of the alliance as widely expected.
"The stake could be taken by someone else," said a Veba spokeswoman. "We are talking to a lot of people. A lot of people are interested."
When asked about U.S.-based SBC, she said: "I cannot comment on that."

Cable and Wireless is expected to withdraw from the venture in a bid to refocus its activities on Britain and Asia. There has been speculation, which has been neither confirmed nor denied, that Cable and Wireless was seeking ties to Global One.
Global One is the joint venture between Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint Corp.
